summary.text: Apply for a cremation permit, then book a slot online or at the service counter.

details.heading: Changes or cancellations
details.body: To change or cancel an approved permit, contact the service counter at Mandai Crematorium directly.

steps.name: Apply for a cremation permit
steps.text: Apply through the NEA ePortal. Submit only one application.

items: Apply for a permit to cremate through the NEA ePortal.

steps.name: Book a cremation slot
steps.text: Book online using the NEA ePortal, or visit the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter during opening hours. Your funeral director can also help.

items: Book online using the NEA ePortal.
Visit the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter during opening hours.

about.text: If you need to change the date or time of a confirmed booking, go in person to the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter.

sources.page_title: Once someone passes on, can I directly proceed to Mandai crematorium to cremate immediately? Do I need to book with NEA?

quotes.text: You do need to apply for a permit to cremate via the NEA ePortal. You should submit only one application.

To book a cremation slot at Mandia Crematorium, you can: Visit the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter (during opening hours) Book online using the NEA ePortal Your funeral director can help you with this.
If you need to make changes to the date or time of the confirmed booking, please do so in person at the Mandai Crematorium Service Counter.
If you need to make changes or cancel the approved permit, contact the service counter at Mandai Crematorium directly.
